# Heterogeneous_Compute_Graph

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational graph where nodes represent different ASIC types (e.g., matrix engines, vector units) and edges represent dataflow across chiplets. Enables TCC/iNEST to optimize task mapping and communication scheduling across mixed compute resources, reducing data movement bottlenecks.
